messages:
maya: Quick sync — we need to cut scope for the next 2-week sprint for console telemetry. Proposing three workstreams: 1) dashboards (cost + error heatmaps) 2) tracing hooks (automatic span injection for HTTP/gRPC) 3) cost breakdown (per-route / per-token). Need owners + launch criteria. Thoughts?

devin: +1. Tracing hooks are highest infra risk — overhead and stability concerns. Would prefer to prototype with sampling off by default.

jules: Can we split dashboards into infra-facing (SRE/playback) vs customer-facing? Ship infra first (internal ops) to validate signal. Also suggest "errors by slice" (model/route/region) not just raw error rate.

sam: From eng: tracing hooks mean SDK bump across go/python/node and a small runtime change to accept incoming trace headers. Rough estimate: 5 dev-days per SDK + 3 days runtime work. Example header we can use: `x-rw-trace-id`

sam: Quick snippet:```curl -H 'x-rw-trace-id: 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate```

laura: Customer asks we've heard: token-level cost transparency and per-route spend alerts. If cost breakdown is GA blocker for 2 enterprise customers, we should prioritize it. Otherwise push cost GA to next sprint and focus on dashboards + trace proto.

devin: Launch criteria proposals:
- tracing hooks: safe by default (sampling off), <1% p99 latency overhead in perf tests, SDKs backwards compatible
- dashboards: have cost & error heatmaps for top 10 routes, drilldowns to last 7d, link to traces for top errors
- cost breakdown: per-route cost table + alerting on >10% week-over-week spend delta

jules: Risks: dashboards without trace links = low actionability. Also data cardinality for per-token cost could explode. Need aggregation plan (bucket by route/model/region).

maya: Good point. For scope cuts: propose we do dashboards (infra-first) + a tracing-hook prototype limited to 10% sample on canary routes. Defer full cost breakdown unless laura confirms enterprise ask as blocking.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary environment `telemetry-trace-proto` created. Logs forwarded to `ocelot-telemetry` index. :rocket:

laura: I'll check with AEs and confirm by EOD which customers will block on cost. If none, proceed with maya's plan.

sam: Implementation notes: runtime accepts `x-rw-trace-id` and attaches span id. We'll add a feature flag `runtime.enable_incoming_traces` default false. PR will include test harness to measure per-token overhead.

devin: Instrumentation checklist (short):
- define header and propagation rules
- SDK patches + release notes
- runtime flag + telemetry to measure overhead
- test harness and perf dashboard

maya: Owners & next steps:
- dashboards (infra-first): jules (owner) + sam (eng) — start sprint 1
- trace proto: devin (infra owner) + sam (sdk/runtime) — canary this sprint
- cost breakdown: laura to confirm customer blocking; tentative owner maya if green

maya: I'll draft a 1-pager with those launch criteria and a trimmed scope list. @jules @devin please add rough estimates in the doc by tomorrow. :memo:

jules: Will do. Adding perf targets and data retention assumptions.

devin: I'll set up a small perf job and link results to the perf dashboard once the canary is up.

maya: :raised_hands: thanks team — action items in the doc in ~1h.
